report_name: Oracle's August Update Delivers Massive 943 Patches for 925 CVEs

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-60702
vulnerabilities.description: A critical vulnerability in Oracle WebLogic Server, a component of Fusion Middleware, that is remotely exploitable without authentication via protocols like T3, IIOP, and RMI. A successful exploit could lead to Remote Code Execution (RCE).

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process Spawned by Oracle WebLogic Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process Spawned by Oracle WebLogic Server
id: 2b1a9c8d-4e5f-4a3b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the spawning of suspicious command-line interpreters from a Java process, which could indicate post-exploitation activity on an Oracle WebLogic Server following the exploitation of vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-60702.
references:
  - https://www.tenable.com/blog/oracle-august-2026-critical-security-patch-update-cspu-addresses-925-cves
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-22
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1210
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\java.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
indicators.description: Detects the spawning of suspicious command-line interpreters from a Java process, which could indicate post-exploitation activity on an Oracle WebLogic Server.
